DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Promyelocytic Leukemia.

The CBC results showing severe thrombocytopenia, leukocytosis with immature cells, and specifically the needle-shaped cytoplasmic inclusions (Auer rods) on the smear are pathognomonic for this condition, making an iron deficiency diagnosis clinically incorrect.
